zones.what: Lifeboats are mounted at Deck 7; they obstruct the view downward and outward from Decks 7, 8, and 9, with Deck 7 cabins sitting at lifeboat level experiencing the most direct obstruction.
zones.effect: Ocean view and balcony cabins on these decks look out at or over orange boats rather than straight down to the water; the horizon remains visible but the view lacks the open sweep of higher decks.
zones.mattersTo: Matters greatly to guests who want unobstructed water views or photos without boat hardware; less important to those prioritizing price, stability, or easy stair access to public areas.

zones.what: Deck 10 directly above hosts the main pool, Bora Bora Pool Bar, and surrounding pool deck in the mid and aft sections.
zones.effect: Mid and aft Deck 9 cabins sit one deck below the daytime social hub; expect foot traffic, deck chair dragging, and music from mid-morning until evening, loudest in afternoon.
zones.mattersTo: Problematic for light sleepers, daytime nappers, or anyone working remotely; non-issue for guests out exploring during the day or those who sleep deeply.

zones.what: Deck 10 directly above has the buffet restaurant (Il Patio) in the forward section.
zones.effect: Forward Deck 9 cabins sit below the buffet; expect early morning setup noise, chair movement, and foot traffic from breakfast service starting around 6:30 AM, continuing through late evening.
zones.mattersTo: Significant for anyone wanting to sleep past 7 AM or seeking quiet evenings in the cabin; less important to early risers or those rarely in the cabin during meal hours.

zones.what: Deck 11 directly below has the Teatro la Fenice (main theatre) in the forward section, with showtimes typically at night.
zones.effect: All Deck 12 suites sit above the theatre; show audio and applause may be audible through the floor during evening performances, usually 9:30–11 PM.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to early-to-bed guests or those sensitive to evening vibration and bass; minimal impact on night owls or those attending the shows themselves.

zones.what: Deck 7 directly below contains the Teatro la Fenice (main theatre) spanning two decks in the forward section.
zones.effect: Forward Deck 8 cabins sit above the upper balcony of the theatre; evening show audio and crowd noise may transmit upward, typically 9:30–11 PM.
zones.mattersTo: Relevant for guests retiring early or needing quiet for calls or sleep by 9 PM; not an issue for those out late or attending shows.

zones.what: Primary elevator and stair banks are located mid-ship on all guest cabin decks, with forward and aft sections farther from vertical circulation.
zones.effect: Mid-ship cabins offer the shortest walk to elevators and stairs but may experience door chimes, conversation, and foot traffic; forward and aft cabins trade convenience for quieter hallways.
zones.mattersTo: Convenience matters to guests with mobility limits, heavy luggage, or young children; quiet matters more to light sleepers or those prioritizing cabin tranquility over access speed.

zones.what: Engine room sits low and aft; Decks 7 and 8 aft cabins are closest to propulsion machinery.
zones.effect: Aft cabins on these decks may experience low-frequency vibration and hum when the ship is underway, most noticeable at night in calm seas or during maneuvering.
zones.mattersTo: Significant for vibration-sensitive sleepers or those bothered by mechanical noise; typically imperceptible to sound sleepers or guests accustomed to ship operations.

zones.what: Bow thrusters are located low and forward; forward cabins on lower decks may experience thruster noise during docking and maneuvering in port.
zones.effect: Forward cabins on these decks may hear loud mechanical grinding or humming during port arrival and departure, typically early morning and late evening, lasting 10–30 minutes per event.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to light sleepers or those in port-intensive itineraries with frequent maneuvering; less relevant on sea days or to guests who sleep through mechanical noise.

zones.what: Anchor equipment is located at the bow; Deck 12 forward suites sit several decks above the anchor chain mechanism.
zones.effect: Matters to guests who value sleeping in on port days; the noise is brief (5–15 minutes) and non-issue for early risers or those expecting port arrival sounds.
